question: Choose the correct sentence
options: Neither the Chairman nor the members was Present .
Neither the Chairman nor the members were present .
Neither the Chairman nor the members has present .
Neither the Chairman nor the members is present .
correct_answer: Neither the Chairman nor the members were present .
explanation:
🔖যখন বিভিন্ন person এর subject , 'or' nor, either .... or , neither ..... nor দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়, তখন শেষে যে person
এর subject বসে, verb সেই person অনুযায়ী হয় । অপশন (খ) তে nor এর পর subject টি plural হওয়ার কারণে verb
টি plural হয়েছে।
hints: 📖Either...or, neither...nor দ্বারা যুক্ত subject যদি ভিন্ন ভিন্ন person এর হয় তবে verb টি শেষ subject অনুযায়ী হয়। Members থাকায় তাই were হবে।
subject: অনির্ধারিত

question: Choose the correct sentence
options: When we saw her last, she ran to catch a bus.
When we saw her last, she had ran to catch a bus.
When we saw her last, she was running to catch a bus.
When we saw her last , she has ran to catch a bus.
correct_answer: When we saw her last, she was running to catch a bus.
explanation:
🔖“when” conjunction has an important function to compare two short- and long-term actions in English. But the tip here is that short-term action is used in Simple Past Tense and the “when” conjunction is placed before the action to emphasize this action. The comma in “while” is also a valid property for the “when” conjunction.
Example:
When the doorbell rang, I was sleeping.
John was playing the guitar when Linda came in.
Formulation:
(When) + (Simple Past Tense) (,)--> (Past Continuous Tense)
(Past Continuous Tense) (When) --> (Simple Past Tense)
SO,'When we saw her last, she was running to catch a bus.'-Is correct
hints: 📖বাক্যটির subordinate clause টি এটাই নির্দেশ করে যে principal clause এর কর্তারা subordinate clause এর কর্তাকে কিছু করায় রত (Continuous in past) দেখেছিলেন কিন্তু সে কাজটা তখনও সমাপ্ত করতে পারে নি বিধায় ‘she was running to catch a bus’ হবে সঠিক subordinate clause।

The doll had been lost by the baby
The doll has been lost by the baby
The doll will have been lost by the baby
correct_answer: The doll has been lost by the baby
explanation:
🔖Object কে Subject এ রুপান্তর + Subject অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb
এর past participle + by + subject কে Object এ রুপান্তর। The baby has lost the
doll - বাক্যটি present perfect tense, passive করতে হলে, পরবর্তী tense . অর্থাৎ present perfect
continuous tense - এর Auxiliary verb ( has been ) গ্রহণ করতে হয়। অর্থাৎ উক্ত বাক্যটির passive voice হলো
The doll has been lost by the baby. অতএব সঠিক উত্তর (গ) ।
hints: 📖The baby has lost the doll - বাক্যটি present perfect tense এ আছে। Passive করতে হলে, present perfect continuous tense - এর Auxiliary verb (has been) গ্রহণ করতে হবে। এবং Passive এ রূপান্তরের বেসিক Structure “Object কে Subject এ রুপান্তর + Subject অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + by + subject কে Object এ রুপান্তর” অনুসরণ করে passive করা যাবে।

=(৩০-২৫) জন
= ৫ জন
